product_metadata.title: Comqualife Stretch Printed Dining Chair Seat Covers, Removable Washable Anti-Dust Upholstered Chair Seat Cover for Dining Room, Kitchen, Office (Set of 6, Geometric-A)
features: Fashion Chair Protector: Fashion printed pattern design, not only keep your new chair from getting dirty and slight scratches, but also giving your old damaged chair a new look. Enjoy a warmly meal time.

High-Quality Material: 92% polyester and 8% spandex. Stretchy enough to fit most of dining upholstered chairs snugly. High-grade fabrics makes the chair cover durable, wrinkle-resistant, anti-pilling, soft and comfortable.

Easy to Install & Care: Just slip it gently over with a "lip" chair seat cushion and lace up it, elastic band and 4 ties hold cover securely in place, avoids slipping or slide around. If you remove the seat cushion, slip and flat the surfaces, tighten drawstring and reinstall this cushion will perfect fit. Machine washable; Tumble dry low; Iron on warm heat.

Fitted Chair Seat Sizes: We do recommend to see the Measuring Guide in pictures to measuring your chair seat size before purchase to ensure have the perfect fit: Chair seat cushion width 14''-20'' and depth 14''-20'' and thickness 1.5''-3''.
Multiple Occasions: Elastic stretch dining chair slipcover, suitable for office chairs, dinning room chairs, bar stools chairs, patio chairs, a perfect decoration to renew and restyle your chairs.
